column13: H1: a per-anchor multiplicative correction removes systematic bias. Leave-one-city-out: each city's factor is fitted on the other dev cities only. Anchors without dev references are unchanged.
Calibrated replay of 001-v11-haiku-baseline: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction.
Calibrated replay of 001-v11-haiku-baseline: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction, hierarchical shrink 3 towards the global anchor factor.
Calibrated replay of 001-v11-haiku-baseline: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction, shrink 5.
H2: state concrete serving sizes and venue types for the food and drink anchors, and ask for the typical price at ordinary venues. The production table leaves serving size and venue class open.
Calibrated replay of 002-spec-definitions: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction.

H8: give the model observed reference prices for three comparable dev cities (same country, else same region) through the app's existing EXTRA_CONTEXT slot. Leave-one-out; test cities are never shown. In production this would be a curated reference table.
Calibrated replay of 007-comparable-context: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction.
Calibrated replay of 007-comparable-context: leave-one-city-out per-anchor multiplicative correction.
H3: the legacy CSV underprices meals and coffee by about 25%, consistent with stale price memory. Tell the model its remembered prices may be dated and to bring them forward to the reference date.
Calibrated replay of 003-current-prices: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction.
H4: models remember local prices in local currency. Ask for the ten anchors in the local currency and convert with frozen FX, removing the model's own currency conversion.
Calibrated replay of 004-local-currency: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction.
H5: asking for a short concrete local example behind each anchor (a dish, a venue type, a local-currency price) grounds the number in specific recall instead of a generic level.
Calibrated replay of 005-anchor-basis: leave-one-city-out per-anchor x region multiplicative correction.

Cost test: identical v1.1 prompts with reasoning effort high instead of max (about 70k output tokens per task at max). If accuracy after calibration is equivalent, later research runs and production calls get several times cheaper.
